target.title: fix(slack): omit replyToId for non-reply messages
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #102457 — non-reply Slack messages have `reply_to_id` equal to their own
`message_id`, causing the agent to thread replies incorrectly.

## Root Cause

`resolveSlackThreadContext` sets `replyToId = incomingThreadTs ?? messageTs`
unconditionally. `isThreadReply` is computed but never gates `replyToId`.
`resolveSlackThreadTargets` in the same file already applies this gating.

## Fix

Gate `replyToId` on `isThreadReply`. One line in `extensions/slack/src/threading.ts`.

## Evidence

### End-to-end proof — Conversation info metadata

```
resolveSlackThreadContext:

BEFORE (main):
  Plain message:      {"message_id":"111","reply_to_id":"111"} ← BUG
  Thread root:        {"message_id":"222","reply_to_id":"222"} ← BUG
  Genuine reply:      {"message_id":"456","reply_to_id":"123"}  ✓

AFTER (this PR):
  Plain message:      {"message_id":"111","reply_to_id":null}  ✓
  Thread root:        {"message_id":"222","reply_to_id":null}  ✓
  Genuine reply:      {"message_id":"456","reply_to_id":"123"}  ✓
```

### Tests

```
threading.test.ts + prepare.test.ts + prepare.thread-session-key.test.ts + inbound-meta.test.ts
Test Files  3 passed (3)  Tests  140 passed (140)
```

```
overall: patch is correct (0.97)
```
